name: zotero-siyuan
description: Send a Zotero PDF reader annotation and its comment to your SiYuan daily note.
author: loonghfut

scripts.build: node tools/bump-version.mjs && zotero-plugin build && node tools/sync-xpi.mjs
scripts.build:ci: node tools/bump-version.mjs --no-bump && zotero-plugin build && node tools/sync-xpi.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run build:ci && npm run check
